# Jeffry.in

> Personal website and blog of Jeff Wainwright, a Principal Engineer writing about software engineering, open source, AI, developer tooling, and life.

The site contains original articles and tutorials. Publication dates appear on each article. Use the archive for the complete catalog and the JSON feed for machine-readable metadata.

## About

- [About Jeff Wainwright](https://jeffry.in/about/)
- [Resume](https://jeffry.in/resume/)

## Selected Articles

- [Why Pastoralist](https://jeffry.in/why-pastoralist/): Research and tooling for dependency overrides.
- [When the AI Token Gravy Train Stops](https://jeffry.in/expensive-ai/): Analysis of AI coding-agent token costs.
- [Being a US-based Software Engineer in 2025](https://jeffry.in/us-swe-economy-2025/): Data-driven employment and wage trends.
- [Shiki Syntax Highlighting](https://jeffry.in/shiki-syntax/): Advanced syntax highlighting for Markdown.
